author: 1993 whispering D
text: Great company to do business with, the ladies at the front really nice, friendly and knowledgeable.  WE Ptarmigan contracting done few rentals and got good commercial products from them.

author: Ginnette Navas
text: Great company to rent from! I rented the Genie TZ-50. It was the perfect equipment for our needs. I called to have it an extra day and a they were able to accommodate my needs.

author: Jessica McMath
text: Dakota Diggers is wonderful. We were able to rent a log splitter. They offer a military discount which is always a perk. The thing that stood out most is that my 4 year old daughter went in with my husband. They gave her a free hat so she could look like her daddy. That gesture was so heartwarming. They are family oriented and so very kind. Thank you Dakota Diggers for the amazing experience. We will be sure to rent here again.

author: Justin Jay
text: Excellent customer service and prices - The front office staff were extremely patient with us as this was our first time landscaping and were more than willing to provide great advice. The delivery driver was top notch and friendly - Couldn't ask for more!

author: Kenneth Cook
text: Our Community is very fortunate to have the Dakota Diggers rooted here. Over the years I have used the equipment rentals, materials hauling & excavation services multiple times. Always the final project and quality of work exceeded my expectations. Recently had a 450' section of our property on a steep Eagle River hillside excavated, contoured to our existing driveway, heavily graveled on top of matting and compacted all for a fraction of what others would charge! Honest, reliable and dependable family business.
